summary: Postinstall auto-executes bundled opaque Windows binary with screen-capture payload
details: Package declares a postinstall script that launches DakuMangalSingh\DakuMangalSingh.exe on every npm install. The tarball ships a 455KB Windows PE launcher (jpackage), a full embedded Java runtime under runtime/, and app/virus.jar as an opaque payload; the declared main: index.js is not present. The bundled virus.jar contains classes named Main, Fetch, and Screenshort, consistent with screen-capture and outbound network fetch behavior on Windows installers. The package name (dakumangalsingh_virus) and the jar name (virus.jar) self-identify the payload. No source, README, or documented purpose accompanies the binaries; installers cannot inspect what runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
